name: Check IP Configuration
description: Displays all current TCP/IP network configuration values.

name: Ping Host
description: Sends ICMP echo requests to verify network connectivity.

name: Test TCP Port Connection
description: Tests network connection to a remote computer on a specific port.

name: Active Network Connections
description: Displays active TCP connections and listening ports with PID.

name: DNS Lookup
description: Queries Domain Name System (DNS) to obtain domain name or IP address.

name: Trace Route to Host
description: Traces the path network packets take to a remote host.

name: List IP Addresses
description: Retrieves local IP addresses configured on all network adapters.

name: Flush DNS Cache
description: Clears and resets the contents of the DNS client resolver cache.

name: Find Files by Extension
description: Recursively searches directory for files matching a pattern.

name: Quick Recursive File Listing
description: Lists all matching files in current directory and subdirectories in bare format.

name: Tail Log File
description: Monitors a log file live as new lines are appended.

name: Robust File Copy
description: Reliably copies files and directory trees with restartability and retries.

name: Search Text Inside Files
description: Searches for text patterns inside files recursively.

name: Display Directory Tree
description: Graphically displays the directory structure of a path including files.

name: Create ZIP Archive
description: Creates a compressed zip archive from specified files or directories.

name: Extract ZIP Archive
description: Unpacks files from a specified zip archive.

name: Get System Information
description: Displays detailed configuration information about the computer and operating system.

name: Detailed Computer Info
description: Retrieves comprehensive operating system and hardware properties in PowerShell.

name: Check System Uptime
description: Calculates how long the Windows system has been running since last boot.

name: System File Checker Scan
description: Scans integrity of all protected system files and replaces corrupted ones.

name: Check Installed Hotfixes
description: Lists installed Windows updates and patches sorted by date.

name: Generate Battery Report
description: Generates a detailed HTML battery performance and health report on laptops.

name: Get Computer Hostname
description: Prints the NetBIOS name of the current computer.

name: Top CPU Consuming Processes
description: Lists the top 10 processes consuming the most CPU time.

name: Top Memory Consuming Processes
description: Lists the top 10 processes using the largest amount of RAM.
example: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object Name, WS

name: Verbose Process List
description: Displays running processes with window titles and memory usage.

name: Force Kill Process by Name
description: Forcefully terminates all processes matching the specified name.

name: Force Kill Process via CMD
description: Terminates one or more tasks or processes by process image name.

name: Find Process Command Line
description: Inspects full command-line arguments used to launch running processes.

name: Check Disk Volumes
description: Lists local disk volumes, drive letters, file systems, and free space.

name: List Disk Drives Space
description: Queries total capacity and remaining free bytes on logical drives.

name: PowerShell File System Drives
description: Displays storage usage and free space on mapped filesystem drives.

name: Disk Free Space via fsutil
description: Queries total free bytes and available quota on the specified volume.

name: List Local User Accounts
description: Retrieves all user accounts configured on the local machine.

name: List Users via Net Command
description: Lists local user accounts using Windows networking command.

name: Inspect Current User Privileges
description: Shows user name, security identifiers (SID), group membership, and privileges.

name: List Active Sessions
description: Displays information about active user sessions on the computer.

name: List Local Groups
description: Retrieves local security groups such as Administrators and Users.

name: Grep File Content (Select-String)
description: Searches for matching regex patterns across multiple files like grep.

name: Locate Executable Path
description: Displays the exact filesystem location of executable files on PATH.

name: Find PowerShell Cmdlet
description: Searches all available PowerShell cmdlets, functions, and aliases.

name: Find Large Files (>500MB)
command: Get-ChildItem -Path C:\ -Recurse -File | Where-Object Length -gt 500MB | Select-Object FullName, Length
description: Finds files larger than 500 megabytes across the system.

name: List Running Windows Services
description: Retrieves all currently active and running Windows services.

name: Query Service Status via SC
description: Queries status and configuration of services using the Service Controller.

name: Restart Windows Service
description: Stops and immediately restarts a Windows service.

name: Start Service via Net
description: Lists all services currently started on the system.

name: Stop Service via Net
description: Stops a running Windows service using the net command.

name: Environment Variables in PowerShell
description: Lists all current environment variables and their values.

name: Environment Variables in CMD
description: Displays, sets, or removes cmd environment variables.

name: Check Windows Defender Status
description: Retrieves status of Windows Defender antivirus signatures and engine.
